headlines.title: Daylight saving time ends Sunday. Here’s what to know as clocks ‘fall back.’
headlines.description: Clocks across much of the United States will fall back once again Sunday as daylight saving time comes to an end.

headlines.title: MAHA fractures deepen as some RFK Jr. followers turn into harsh critics
headlines.description: A scorecard from MAHA activists suggests the Trump administration has broken most of its promises to the movement. The “burn feels especially raw,” one prominent activist said.

headlines.title: South Korea is fighting its baby bust and could be a model for battling population decline
headlines.description: South Korea, dealing with one of the lowest fertility rates in the world, is trying to change course by offering loads of incentives for young adults to have kids. The real solution might not be only economic, but cultural too. NBC News' Janis Mackey Frayer reports from Seoul.

headlines.title: FDA plans to update nutritional rules for infant formula
headlines.description: The Food and Drug Administration plans to introduce new rules around what nutrients must be added to infant formula. The changes the FDA plans to propose, which were shared in advance with NBC News, would tweak the minimum and maximum levels of four nutrients: iodine, manganese, vitamin A and vitamin D.

headlines.title: Pat Croce Shares Lessons From ‘Enjoy Yourself Now!’
headlines.description: Pat Croce, the enthusiastic former president and co-owner of the Philadelphia 76ers who once climbed the Walt Whitman Bridge to hang the team’s banner, joins TODAY talk about his new book “Enjoy Yourself Now! 66 Sacred Shifts to Instantly Awaken the Peaceful Presence Within You.”

headlines.title: Clocks Change This Weekend: What You Can Do Now to Adjust
headlines.description: This weekend, Daylight Saving Time ends and even though we “fall back” and gain an extra hour, it can still mess with our body clocks. Dr. Mike Varshavski, board certified family medicine physician, joins TODAY to share ways to keep your sleep cycle on track.

headlines.title: Amazon just marked down this Fire tablet by 53% until it sells out
headlines.description: Amazon is replacing Fire tablets with its new Alexa tablets, and the Fire HD 10 is now 53% off while supplies last. Here’s what you get for the price.

headlines.title: Talking Shop with Becky G
headlines.description: Singer Becky G takes gift giving very seriously. These are some of her favorite products to give to loved ones, especially from small businesses.

headlines.title: Brooks Glycerin Flex Running Sneakers are almost $70 off during NYC marathon weekend
headlines.description: It’s NYC Marathon weekend, and the cushioned, flexible Brooks Glycerin Flex is nearly $70 off at Nordstrom. Other Brooks styles are on sale too.

headlines.title: 19+ products we tried and gave our stamp of approval in October
headlines.description: October is when the real holiday shopping starts, and this month we tried new barrel jeans, Jellycat plushies, hairstyling appliances, kitchen accessories and more.

headlines.title: Get Plant-Based Protein at Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner With Dietitian-Approved Recipes
headlines.description: Whether or not you eat meat, eating more plant-foods has tons of health benefits. Try these dietitian-approved recipes to get plant protein at every meal.

headlines.title: Richard Norton, actor and martial artist, died after peptides triggered heart attack, coroner says
headlines.description: Australian actor and martial artist Richard Norton, who faced off in movies against Chuck Norris and Jackie Chan, died of a heart attack tiggered by peptides, according to a coroner’s report.
